Vale__Dependencies__ImportMap__Index__.description: Browser import-map targets for the version-locked vendor libraries used by ValeVision3D. Paths are relative to index.html (the ValeVision3D root). This file is the SSOT for the import map declared inline in index.html; a browser cannot read an import map from JSON, so the two must be kept in sync by hand. Keys are identical to the Vale Lantern Designer import map so the projected linework modules port between the two apps without edits.
Vale__Dependencies__ImportMap__Index__.coordinatedSetNote: Do not upgrade three / three-mesh-bvh / clipper2-js / three-edge-projection independently; vendors 01 to 04 form one coordinated 3D and projection set and must move together with the Lantern Designer copy. Vendor 03 (clipper2-js) is imported by three-edge-projection's SilhouetteGenerator at module load, so the import map must carry it even though no ValeVision3D module calls it directly (added 10-Sep-2026, v2.21.1). jsPDF is vendored separately under 02__Src__AppModules/35__System__PageLayoutSystem/01__Dependencies__VersionLocked and is not part of this set.

01__Vendor__ThreeJs__v0.184.0.coreNote: three.module.js imports ./three.core.js relatively; both files must ship and both are precached by the shared service worker.

03__Vendor__Clipper2Js__v0.9.0.usedBy: 04__Vendor__ThreeEdgeProjection (SilhouetteGenerator imports Path64, Clipper and FillRule at module load); no ValeVision3D module imports it directly

04__Vendor__ThreeEdgeProjection__v0.0.10.usedBy: 50__System__ProjectedLinework (legacy reference backend for the diff harness, WebGPU backend, vendored intersection generator)
04__Vendor__ThreeEdgeProjection__v0.0.10.knownUpstreamBug: utils/bvhcastEdges.js line 55 compares a number to a boolean so FrontSide meshes never backface cull; the ported soup builder fixes this before the kernel ever sees a triangle.
